title: Included Finish Levels in Each Design Studio Selections Package
content:
Each Design Studio Selections package includes a level of cabinetry, countertops and flooring, and may include the upgraded appliance package and the smart home package. Cabinet and countertop levels run from 1 to 5 and flooring levels from 1 to 4; a level above the one included is an option line.

| Package | Upgraded appliance package included | Cabinet level included | Countertop level included | Flooring level included | Smart home package included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | No | 1 | 1 | 1 | No |
| Studio Classic | No | 1 | 2 | 1 | No |
| Studio Select | Yes | 2 | 2 | 2 | No |
| Studio Designer | Yes | 3 | 3 | 2 | Yes |
| Studio Signature | Yes | 4 | 4 | 3 | Yes |
| Studio Atelier | Yes | 5 | 5 | 4 | Yes |

**Notes**

- Where the upgraded appliance package is included, appliance lines are priced net of it.
- Studio Atelier includes the top level of every finish: cabinet level 5, countertop level 5 and flooring level 4.

*Hypothetical illustration:* level 3 countertops chosen on a Studio Classic file are one level above the included level 2 and are an option line; the same level 3 countertops on a Studio Designer file are at the included level.
